note: BLM (Barstow Field Office) campground in Afton Canyon, part of Mojave Trails National Monument, one of the few places the Mojave River flows above ground year-round. Each site has a shade ramada, table, fire pit and grill. Piped water is only sometimes available, so bring water. From I-15 35 mi E of Barstow, take the Afton exit and drive 3 mi S on a graded dirt road (2WD OK). Campfire permit required. The area is also a staging point for OHV and 4x4 touring in the monument. --Claude
